subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Which open Z.AI User-Agent fix PR should be treated as the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, and several open PRs claim the same closing fix, so maintainers need to pick or land one rather than spawning another repair PR.

options.title: Review and land the strongest linked fix

options.title: Ask for live Z.AI proof first

options.title: Close duplicate PRs after choosing
options.body: Once a canonical PR is selected, close the redundant same-fix PRs to reduce review noise.

recommendation.title: Review and land the strongest linked fix
